cause.derivation: A viewer cannot understand a chosen detour without perceiving both the threat and the option.
cause.method: Block threat and route as two screen-space targets; test head occlusion and screen direction across the camera move. Label viewer-right versus actor-right explicitly.
cause.early_proof: Untextured intended-framing sequence: identify both targets without explanatory captions.
cause.failure_condition: Either route hidden, direction reverses without reorientation, or viewer cannot connect glance to choice.
cause.reopen_when: Camera, source authority, performance, contacts or coupled assets change; previous evidence no longer covers the shot.

decision_distance.derivation: Speed, sight distance and response time must support the maneuver.
decision_distance.method: Measure remaining path distance against approach speed, recognition duration and stop/turn travel before fixing checkpoint placement.
decision_distance.early_proof: Top-down trajectory and actual-camera rough motion from recognition to turn.
decision_distance.failure_condition: Horse is already at the barrier before the apparent decision could take effect.
decision_distance.reopen_when: Camera, source authority, performance, contacts or coupled assets change; previous evidence no longer covers the shot.

continuous_weight.derivation: A dramatic change of direction requires rider balance, hoof purchase and displaced dirt to agree.
continuous_weight.method: Author shared contact events for body lean, hoof plants and world-space dirt release; reserve full-body visibility during the decisive movement.
continuous_weight.early_proof: Whole-body motion and contact crops, not independently passing components.
continuous_weight.failure_condition: Turn reads as teleport, floating slide or rider detached from acceleration.
continuous_weight.reopen_when: Camera, source authority, performance, contacts or coupled assets change; previous evidence no longer covers the shot.
